logic_errors: [P1] app/live_sessions.py:22-28,55-57,97-107: Malformed numeric telemetry can break the entire sessions API rather than being contained per provider. checked_snapshot accepts oversized integers; timestamp calls math.isfinite before its exception handler, and session_view evaluates context.percent_used before validating token counts. Read-only probes reproduced OverflowError from both context.event_time=10**1000 and occupancy used=10**1000. Validate bounded values before timestamp conversion or percentage calculation and contain serialization failures.

[P2] app/live_sessions.py:47,54-57: Percentage eligibility does not use the validated context_freshness. A numeric-string context timestamp is exported as context_event_time=null and context_freshness='unknown', but canonical percent_used accepts that string through float conversion. An in-memory probe returned percent_used=10.0 with unknown context freshness, violating the no-false-occupancy requirement.

[P2] app/ui/app.js:42-59: Neither fetch nor response-body parsing has a timeout. A request that never settles leaves refreshInFlight=true indefinitely, preventing manual refresh and reconnect attempts. On the initial request, schedule is never reached and the connection-error banner remains hidden. A Node VM probe reproduced one fetch call, a permanently held guard, and no installed polling timer.

[P2] app/ui/telemetry.js:19-29; app/ui/app.js:649: Cached rows age their freshness classifications but retain the original age_sec and session_age_sec. During transport loss, the Updated column can continue saying '2s ago' long after the event expires. A read-only probe advanced the clock by 400 seconds: session_freshness became 'expired', but age_sec remained 2.

[P2] app/tests/browser-live.cjs:72-81; app/ui/index.html:39-58; app/ui/style.css:130: The new list/detail acceptance checks are false positives: they inspect textContent without checking visibility. The details panel lives inside boardView, which list mode hides. Selecting a list row therefore does not reveal the new detail metadata. The supplied list-details-live.png confirms a selected row without a visible details panel; hidden DOM text does not establish working detail presentation.

[P2] app/ui/app.js:78-83,711-743: Selecting a session outside the first six changes sceneSessions immediately but does not synchronize mobile tiles. select calls updateTileTags and kickRender, neither of which creates the newly selected tile. A Node VM probe selected s6: the scene contained s6 while mobile tiles still contained s5. Switching back to sector view retains that mismatch until the next periodic render.

[P2] app/live_sessions.py:164-179,245-246: Retired provider reads are never reaped. poll_once waits on every _inflight entry but removes entries only for currently registered adapters. After unregistering a provider, even its completed future remains retained permanently; a hung retired reader also continues consuming every poll's timeout. Probes reproduced both retained completed futures and timeout waits with an empty registry. Repeated provider registration/removal can accumulate retired readers/results.
